instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium shot. In a minimalist white bedroom, a bearded man in a patterned black t-shirt (R1) and a woman in a black tank top with a red plaid skirt (R2) interact playfully. The woman (R2) stands on the left, looking down with a smile while gesturing with her hands. The man (R1) stands on the right, looking at her and gesturing mid-conversation. Bright, soft indoor lighting illuminates the couple, emphasizing the warm, casual mood and neutral background.
